nodes.name: Read Execution Logs
nodes.notes:
📊 READ EXECUTION LOGS

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:

1. Google Sheets credential
2. Sheet ID
3. Sheet: 'Logs'
4. Filter: workflowRunId = current runId

PURPOSE: Gather all logs from this execution

WHAT IT READS:
- Module 1 logs (workflow started)
- Module 4 logs (jobs written)
- Any errors from other modules

USED FOR:
- Summary statistics
- Error detection
- Notification content

nodes.name: Summarize Execution
nodes.notes:
📊 SUMMARIZE EXECUTION

PURPOSE: Create execution summary from all logs

SUMMARY INCLUDES:
- Jobs scraped (Module 2)
- Jobs filtered (Module 3)
- Jobs logged (Module 4)
- Contacts found (Module 6)
- Outreach generated (Module 7)
- Error count
- Overall status

USED FOR:
- Notifications
- Performance tracking
- Error detection

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-summarizes.

nodes.name: Send Telegram Notification
nodes.notes:
📱 TELEGRAM NOTIFICATION

⚠️ CRITICAL SETUP:

1. Create Telegram bot:
   - Message @BotFather on Telegram
   - Send: /newbot
   - Name your bot
   - Copy the API token

2. Get your chat ID:
   - Message your bot
   - Visit: https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates
   - Find your chat ID in the response

3. Configure this node:
   - Credential: Paste bot token
   - Chat ID: Your chat ID
   - Message: Already configured

PURPOSE: Send daily summary to your Telegram

MESSAGE INCLUDES:
- Date and time
- All module statistics
- Error alerts
- Link to Google Sheet

TO CUSTOMIZE:
- Edit the message template
- Add emojis, formatting
- Include/exclude metrics

nodes.name: Send Email Notification
nodes.notes:
📧 EMAIL NOTIFICATION

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:

1. Configure Gmail OAuth:
   - Click 'Select Credential'
   - 'Create New Credential'
   - 'Gmail OAuth2'
   - Sign in with your Gmail
   - Grant permissions

2. Set recipient:
   - 'Send To': YOUR_EMAIL@gmail.com
   - Replace with your actual email

3. Customize message:
   - Already configured with HTML
   - Edit template if needed

PURPOSE: Send formatted email summary

EMAIL INCLUDES:
- HTML formatted summary
- All statistics
- Error alerts (red color)
- Clickable link to Sheet

TO CUSTOMIZE:
- Edit HTML template
- Change colors, styling
- Add charts/graphs
